ayahOccurrences.text: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: بِٱلدُّهْنِ is in the derivative form: دُهْنٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/هـ/ن   d–h–n fat, grease, oil, to be oily, to anoint
; to act hypocritically, to act insincerely; a sprinkle of rain, to wet, to look sprightly; red leather, affluence; desert.

Of this root, 4 forms occur 5 times in the Qur’an:
تُدْهِنُ tudhin 2 times; مُدْهِنُون mudhinūn 1 time; دُهْنٌ duhn 1 time and دِهَانٌ dihān 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
دُهْنٌ duhn [n.] oil

(23:20) وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِلآكِلِينَ and a tree, springing out from Mount Sinai, that produces oil and relish for the eaters.

entries.label: د-هـ-ن
entries.definitionHtml:
د/هـ/ن   d–h–n fat, grease, oil, to be oily, to anoint
; to act hypocritically, to act insincerely; a sprinkle of rain, to wet, to look sprightly; red leather, affluence; desert.

Of this root, 4 forms occur 5 times in the Qur’an:
تُدْهِنُ tudhin 2 times; مُدْهِنُون mudhinūn 1 time; دُهْنٌ duhn 1 time and دِهَانٌ dihān 1 time.

entries.label: دُهْنٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
دُهْنٌ duhn [n.] oil

(23:20) وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِلآكِلِينَ and a tree, springing out from Mount Sinai, that produces oil and relish for the eaters.

entries.label: تُدْهِنُ
entries.definitionHtml:
تُدْهِنُ tudhin [imperf. of v. IV أَدْهَنَ ʾadhana, intrans.] to sweet‐talk, to be sycophantic; to be hypocritical; to compromise, to be reconciliatory

(68:9) وَدُّوا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ they wish you would talk sweet‐talk [to them] and then they will talk sweet‐talk [to you] (or, you would compromise in matters of the religion and then they would compromise in matters of the religion).

entries.label: دِهَانٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
دِهَانٌ dihān [n./pl. of n. دُهْنٌ duhn] red‐painted leather; fat

(55:37) فَإِذَا انْشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ when the sky is torn apart and becomes rose‐red, like red leather (or, like molten/melted fat).

entries.label: مُدْهِنُون
entries.definitionHtml:
مُدْهِنُون mudhinūn [pl. of act. part. مُدْهِن mudhin] (ones acting) hypocritically; compromising, taking things lightly

(56:81) أَفَبِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَنْتُمْ مُدْهِنُونَ do you hold this discourse in little esteem? (or, are you being hypocritical in your attitude towards it?, or, how can you scorn this statement?).
